name: sim_stage_start
notes: stage reset; look-ahead flag checksum; end fix-up; registers 06c9:6269 and 06c9:403b in the timer list

name: sim_timer_routine
notes: 100 Hz timer-list routine; 10 Hz sim tick; 1 Hz clock

name: sound_tick
notes: rpm needle slew; engine/rumble/effect tone divisors DS:5FD8-5FDE

name: decode_controls
notes: demo autopilot; automatic transmission; steer/throttle; gear selection

name: clutch_check
type: near (CX old rpm, DX new rpm)

name: curve_sum
notes: sum of last 8 curve bytes -> DS:30E4; speed -> DS:30E6

name: free_rev
notes: rpm -200 down to 800; or +600 in neutral with throttle

name: update_rpm
notes: rpm = ratio*speed>>16 min 800; nothing in neutral

name: overrev_check
notes: 30 ticks at redline or above max -> run_state 3

name: motion
notes: pull-over; sub-unit step; unit loop (spawn, fuel, grip, yaw, collisions, objects)

name: car_edges
notes: car edges; station and out-of-gas stop checks

name: meet_check
notes: reaching the next car of a list

name: push_behind
notes: keeps same-direction cars behind a driver

name: ai_pick_lane
type: near (AX x) -> CX target, DX gap

name: police_start
notes: police car appears 26 units behind the player

name: police_drive
notes: police movement; may pop the caller return address

name: traffic_resync
notes: clears traffic around the player; finds list indices

name: resync_list
notes: pushes cars out of the window

name: DIFF_UNUSED
notes: difficulty table; not read by the sim

name: onc_next
notes: player index into the oncoming list (x8)

name: same_next
notes: player index into the same-direction list (x8)
